name: Summarize presentation content into structured slide formats
description: Users asked for detailed, professional, and academic summaries of specific presentation sections or articles, frequently specifying a format of six themes with key points and strict constraints regarding tone, length, and the exclusion of AI-related references. While most requests focused on technical and policy topics within a Chinese cybersecurity context, some involved summarizing scientific findings, business strategies, or general work tasks into slide-ready content.
